title: Page 261
transc:
Ft Monroe Nov 4 . 1864
John Horner 
New York
Appian Julia November pension for Knave frog
unity I have taken that not actually
loaded by mull fords and have plenty
for all purposes that I have knowledge
of Youth Webster pandora and Vincent Windy
Geo D Sheldon


Ft. Monroe Nov 4 . 1864
S. H. Beckwith City Point 
Mary forth to Bourse tulip all but the Iolas have
arrived and will be off by Anna of fifth unity
so rough here we had to send boots off Crany
smyrna to transfer Zebra all the boots with Negro spartans
have to go to Portsmouth to have stalls put in
pekin this will Cause delay zodiac the Vincent will fit
them Persia possible open I shall go to Baptism whelp
evening pedlar shelby Hawley goes tonight with squash unity letter
by morning male walrus Babcock Lieut pandora and so forth 
Geo D Sheldon


Butters Hd Qrs Nov 4 1864 
Geo D Sheldon Ft. Monroe
Henrietta Nov penny for pilgrim Langdon plug united states negro
pro pedlar france appian unity if shelby Hawley is gone
when you reach animal open your own letter of instructions
& give Corresponding order to the vassals which have no
letters zebra use all possible despatch walrus Taunton Shelby Barry
R OBrien
